# LEVRAINE

> LEVRAINE makes reusable bread bags for sourdough and artisan loaves. The bread bag
> comes as a set of two XL bags. Each bag has a linen-blend outer and a removable
> liner of 100% cotton coated in 100% beeswax, and closes by rolling the top and
> clipping a strap. LEVRAINE is a brand of Marship Vibraheart Inc., a Canadian
> e-commerce company. The bags are sold on Amazon.ca and Amazon.com.

## The product
- Name: LEVRAINE Beeswax Bread Bags for Sourdough, 2 Pack XL, Removable Liners
- Amazon ASIN: B0H5FXR8X4 (same ASIN on Amazon.ca and Amazon.com)
- In the box: two bags
- Size: 42 x 33 cm (16.5 x 13 in), laid flat before rolling
- Outer: linen blend
- Liner: 100% cotton coated in 100% beeswax; lifts out of the outer bag
- Closure: roll the top down and clip the strap
- Use: on the counter or in the freezer
- Print: "This is my emotional support sourdough."

## How to use it
1. Let the bread cool, then set it inside the liner.
2. Press out the air gently from the bottom up.
3. Roll the top down and clip the strap.

## Care
Lift the liner out and shake out the crumbs. Rinse the liner in cold water,
keep it away from heat, and let it air dry.
